title: Notice to Competitors
summary: Club Course boat start, amended warning signals and replacement courses 1-2.
warningSignals: Division 1 - Code Flag W - no earlier than 1155
Division 2 - Code Flag E - no earlier than 1200

sections.body: This will be a Club Course boat start event, per SI Appendix A.1.

Courses 1-2 of the SYC Sailing Instructions Appendix A.1 are replaced by the courses in this notice. This amends SI 13.2.

Note: The Gate will be laid up to 1.0 nm to windward from the start line.

Course 1: Start - Gate - 5 (Port) - MMYC #4 (Starboard) - 5 (Starboard) - 6 (Starboard) - 3 (Starboard) - 4 (Starboard) - 6 (Starboard) - 3 (Starboard) - 4 (Starboard) - 2 (Starboard) - 3 (Starboard) - Finish. Distance approx. 23.5 nm.

Course 2: Start - Gate - 5 (Port) - MMYC #4 (Starboard) - 5 (Starboard) - 6 (Starboard) - 3 (Starboard) - 4 (Starboard) - 2 (Starboard) - 3 (Starboard) - Finish. Distance approx. 19.5 nm.

The following mark is added to SI 14.3:

MMYC - Yellow conical - 38° 00.777'S, 145° 03.604'E.
